claim: If Amazon EC2 terminates or stops a Spot Instance in its first instance hour, that usage is not charged; if the user stops or terminates it, usage is charged to the nearest second, except on SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES), where a user stop or termination is charged for an entire hour.

qualifiers.scope: Spot Instance billing on stop or interruption
qualifiers.condition: the free first hour applies only when Amazon EC2 stops or terminates the instance; on SLES a user stop or termination is charged for an entire hour

evidence.quote: If your Spot instance is terminated or stopped by Amazon EC2 in the first instance hour, you will not be charged for that usage. However, if you stop or terminate the Spot instance yourself, you will be charged to the nearest second.

If you are running on SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) and you stop or terminate the Spot Instance yourself, you will be charged for an entire hour. All other operating systems, including Linux and Windows, are billed per-second.
